name: composite_demo_compositeservice_run
description: Uppercases the input text via transform-demo, then round-trips the result through echo-device-module's echo action, all in-process over the worker message channel (no HTTP, no model-context round trip for the intermediate steps). Returns the final text plus a call-chain bill with one independent metering record per inner module invoked.

name: countinghouse_check_balance
description: Check the calling API key's current metering balance on this countinghouse instance.

name: echo_device_client_errtestservice_testerrorinfo
description: Returns a device-defined error object (fault) instead of a normal result, to test structured error propagation from a client-side service module.

name: echo_device_client_x_api
description: Demonstrates cross-module invocation: creates a ServiceClient pointed at the echo-device module and calls its echo action with a fixed sample payload, returning whatever echo returns.

name: echo_device_echoservice_echo
description: Echoes the input object back as the output, unmodified. Useful for verifying end-to-end connectivity and input/output schema handling.

name: echo_device_echoservice_echoasync
description: Same as echo, but implemented with an async/await handler instead of a callback -- exercises the async invocation code path.

name: echo_device_errorinfotestservice_testasyncthrowinasync
description: Throws asynchronously inside an async/await-style action handler; expected to be caught by a try/catch block rather than relying on the domain module.

name: echo_device_errorinfotestservice_testasyncthrowindomain
description: Throws asynchronously (outside the initial call stack) inside a callback-style action handler, exercising Node's deprecated domain-module-based exception capture.

name: echo_device_errorinfotestservice_testbooleantypereturnerror
description: Returns a boolean as the error value, to test error normalization when the device module supplies a non-Error error.

name: echo_device_errorinfotestservice_testerrorinfo
description: Returns a device-defined error object (fault) instead of a normal result, to test structured error propagation.

name: echo_device_errorinfotestservice_testerrorinfoasync
description: Async/await version of testErrorInfo: rejects with a device-defined error object to test structured error propagation.

name: echo_device_errorinfotestservice_testfunctionreturnerror
description: Returns a JavaScript Error instance directly from the action function, to test that error type is handled correctly.

name: echo_device_errorinfotestservice_testnullreturnerror
description: Returns null as the error value, to test that a falsy/null error is still treated as "no error" correctly.

name: echo_device_errorinfotestservice_testnumbertypereturnerror
description: Returns a number as the error value, to test error normalization when the device module supplies a non-Error error.

name: echo_device_errorinfotestservice_teststringtypereturnerror
description: Returns a string as the error value, to test error normalization when the device module supplies a non-Error error.

name: echo_device_errorinfotestservice_testthrowerror
description: Directly throws a new Error inside a callback-style action handler, to test that synchronous throws are caught and reported as a fault rather than crashing the process.

name: echo_device_errorinfotestservice_testthrowerrorasync
description: Directly throws a new Error inside an async/await-style action handler, to test that async throws are caught and reported as a fault rather than crashing the process.

name: echo_device_timeouttestservice_testtimeout
description: Intentionally never calls back, so the framework's action timeout fires. Used to test timeout handling; expect a DEVICE_NOT_RESPONDING-style error.

name: echo_device_timeouttestservice_testtimeoutasync
description: Same as testTimeout, but implemented as an async function that never resolves.

name: perf_callee_demo_perfcalleeservice_echopayload
description: Returns the input data unchanged. Benchmark fixture only, not part of any documented public API.

name: perf_caller_demo_perfcallerservice_run
description: Generates a random string of payloadSizeBytes length and round-trips it through perf-callee-demo's echoPayload action over ServiceClient.invoke -- the same isRemoteThread path lib/service-client.js branches on options.directPeerChannels for. Returns the round-trip duration measured server-side, around just the ServiceClient.invoke call (excluding this action's own HTTP/session overhead). Benchmark fixture only, not part of any documented public API.

name: transform_demo_transformservice_uppercase
description: Returns the input text converted to uppercase.
